# FG-AUTH-0022

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 403 |
| 重大度 | info |
| Runbook | [`smart-http`](../../ops/runbooks/smart-http.md) |
| 発生させるテスト | `an_agent_cannot_clone_fetch_or_archive_a_repository_with_a_confidential_document` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: このリポジトリの既定のブランチには機密の文書がある（または確かめられなかった）ため、AI エージェントのアカウントでは clone・fetch・アーカイブの取得ができません。人のアカウントを使ってください。
- en: This repository's default branch holds a confidential document (or it could not be checked), so an AI agent's account cannot clone, fetch or download an archive of it. Use a person's account.
- id: Cabang bawaan repositori ini berisi dokumen rahasia (atau tidak dapat diperiksa), sehingga akun agen AI tidak dapat melakukan clone, fetch, atau mengunduh arsipnya. Gunakan akun orang.

## 原因 (cause)

Plan 06 D-5, ADR-0026 decision of 2026-11-10 (the safety net): an AI agent audience — a token issued with `is_agent`, a service account or a bot (`Principal::is_agent_audience`) — asked for a whole copy of a repository (Smart HTTP clone / fetch: `GET info/refs?service=git-upload-pack` or `POST git-upload-pack`; or `GET -/archive/{ref}.{zip|tar.gz}`), and authorize() (RepoRead on Resource::RepoCopy, forge_auth::authorize_repo_copy) refused it because the default branch's tip was not measured open: `tip_confidential` (forge_checks::confidential found a confidential file there — a spec document with `confidential: true`, a `.md` with `classification: confidential`, its type's default, both keys, or a front matter / type definition that cannot be read), `default_branch_unborn` (HEAD names a branch not born while other refs exist: nothing to measure against, fail closed, as the read routes), `tip_undecided` (the measurement did not complete: its 20 s timeout FG-GIT-0002 operation=confidential_paths, a bound of the document read, or a git error — `check_error` names its code) or `tip_not_measured` (a defect: the route did not measure). Persons are never refused; pushes (receive-pack) are unchanged. Git gets the refusal in-band (HTTP 200 and one `ERR` packet: `fatal: remote error: <message> (request_id: …)`); an archive gets the JSON 403. The operating rule is that confidential documents live in repositories the agent's account cannot read — this refusal is the safety net. It looks only at the default branch's tip: a confidential file only in history or on another branch is not detected. Not a fault.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The log event carries `route` (`info_refs`, `upload_pack`, `archive`), `project_id`, `repo_id`, `reason` (above), `audience` (`agent_token`, `service_account`, `bot`), `tip` (the default branch's commit), `paths` (the first confidential paths, for `tip_confidential`) and, for `tip_undecided`, `check_error` with the cause's own context (`operation`, `timeout_ms`, `bound`). Read the marks at the tip: gstn browse blob --project <id> --ref <tip> --path <path>.

## 対処 (fix)

Expected for an AI agent. Follow runbook smart-http (agents and confidential documents): move the confidential documents to a repository the agent's account cannot read (the operating rule), or clone with a person's account. A wrong mark is corrected in the document's front matter (or its type's default); once the default branch's tip has no confidential file the agent can clone again (the answer is cached per repository and tip commit, so a push changes it at once). `tip_undecided` from a timeout: retry; if it repeats, the repository's documents exceed the bounds — reduce them or use a person's account.
